args.title: Correct the API run command in README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

The README.md documents running the API with `npm run serve`, which does not exist in the package.json scripts. It should be updated to the correct command or script present in package.json to avoid the reported error.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md is the file to change because it incorrectly specifies the command `npm run serve` to run the API, which does not exist in the package.json scripts. Updating this documentation to the correct command prevents the error users see when trying to start the API.
